content:
anya: ok tiny emergency: Shadow (the cat) just executed a perfect bookshelf heist and is sitting on top of my ficus with a succulent in his mouth. pic: https://imgur.com/ShadowHeist.jpg
sam: omg no way 😂 did he dig it out or just pluck it like a tiny burglar?
anya: plucked. like a pro. i swear he has thumbs. @morgan you trained him in heists right?
morgan: never. i only taught him how to open snack drawers :chef: 
cleo: send more pics!!! :heart_eyes: 
anya: uploading a short vid now — it's 3s of very suspect chewing and a triumphant leap. (i'll spare you the crunch sound)
giphy-bot: GIPHY posted "sneaky cat" GIF — https://giphy.com/gifs/sneaky-cat-3o7aD2saalBwwftBIY
sam: that's the vibe. caption: "Asset reallocation"
cleo: (reaction) :rofl: 2
anya: ok i'll replant the succulent and put it on a higher shelf. also considering a tiny harness. thoughts?
morgan: harness is peak content, but also maybe a deterrent? or just decorate the bookshelf with fake plants :smile: 
anya: good idea — fake plants it is. also low-key proud? he's very theatrical.
cleo: proud parent moment :tear_of_joy: 
anya: bonus — he left a single paw-print in the pot. documentation for future blackmail.
sam: more like evidence in case of trial :judge: 
anya: court date TBD. case: "The People v. Shadow the Shelf Bandit" 
cleo: opening arguments: "Too cute to convict" :gavel: 
anya: true. case dismissed on grounds of irresistible loafness.
